A merchant in Kamadan is running low on identification kits so he asks you to go to his supplier, [[Kupekanu]] in [[Champion's Dawn]], and ask him why his shipment is late.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{Standard prerequisites
 |campaign = Nightfall
}}

===Objectives===
* Get information about the shipment of identification kits from Kupekanu at Champion's Dawn.
* Recover the lost shipment crate from the band of corsairs at the Cliffs of Dohjok.
* See Shatam for your reward.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]]
* 10 [[Sunspear Promotion Point]]s
* [[Identification Kit]]
** Uses remaining: 25
* [[Battle Commendation]]

==Walkthrough==
The first part of this quest is merely meant to get you to the outpost Champion's Dawn. It should not be hard to get there, though you should watch out for several [[Mandragor]] emerging from the soil while you travel there. In the outpost, talk to Kupekanu, and he'll tell you that his last shipment was stolen by corsairs. Head out to the [[Cliffs of Dohjok]] and use your compass to get where you need to be. There are three groups of two corsairs here, with one group having the aid of [[Suubay the Greedy]]. Once Suubay is defeated, the [[Shipment Crate]] will drop. Pick it up and take it to [[Shatam]] for your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Shatam'''
:''"I have a favor to ask of you.  My stock of identification kits runs dangerously low and my latest shipment is long overdue.  I fear something has gone wrong.  Can you make an inquiry with '''Kupekanu''' at '''Champion's Dawn''' about my kits?  He is my supplier, so he had better have some answers."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = No problem. I'm headed that way anyway.
|decline = Shouldn't you take this up with customer service?
|ask = Ask '''Kupekanu''' at '''Champion's Dawn''' about the shipment of identification kits. }}

===Intermediate dialogue===
'''Kupekanu'''
:''"Please tell Shatam that I am sorry about his product, but the matter is our of my hands. All of my shipments have been delayed due to recent corsair attacks. His crate was taken during a raid on my latest caravan. If you want it, you'll have to get it from these corsairs. Those blasted corsair raiders have taken up residency somewhere on the Cliffs of Dohjok."''

===Reward dialogue===
'''Shatam'''
:''"Thank you so much, '''<Player Name>'''.  I didn't expect you to go to such lengths to retrieve my identification kits.  As a token of my gratitutde, you may keep one of them.  They are a useful item for an adventurer such as you.  If you come across any unidentified items, simply use the identification kit on that item to uncover any hidden properties it may possess.  And, remember, if you ever need another kit you can always purchase one from me or another merchant."''

==Notes==
* This quest can be performed at the same time as [[Scholarly Affairs]] and [[Leaving a Legacy]].
* Although the leader of the corsair robbers has a name of his own ([[Suubay the Greedy]]), he is not a [[boss]].
